description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ChartDaoTest' for the 'ChartDao' component of the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. It includes setup procedures, mocks, and various test methods for validating employee distribution and count functions performed by the ChartDao.

classes.name: ChartDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ChartDao's functionalities related to employee distribution and counts within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing ChartDao, loading fixture data, and populating the database.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Tests the getUnassignedEmployeeCount method for various subunit ID filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Validates the employee distribution data grouped by subunits, including count and subunit properties.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Validates the employee distribution data grouped by location, including location name, id, and employee count.

methods.name: testGetTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Asserts that the total number of active employees returned matches the expected count.
